text:
emily_partnerships: Quick triage for AcmeAI marketplace listing. Need to confirm: role ARNs for publisher portal, who owns KMS, final trial SKU names, and EULA telemetry language. Can we sort today?

ben_sales: I can loop in the partner rep. Main ask: get manifest validated and role created so they can upload assets.

zoe_legal: Heads-up: GCP reviewers required explicit telemetry opt-in copy + EEA data residency clause. I'll draft short snippets and post.

kevin_eng: For IAM, we prefer a cross-account role with minimal s3 + kms read permissions. Sample inline policy: `s3:GetObject`, `s3:ListBucket` on `arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace-assets/*` and `kms:Decrypt` on the manifest key.

marketplace_bot: Reminder: manifest must include `sku_id`, `display_name`, `pricing_type`, `support_contact`. Upload to s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/ACMEAI-42/ by EOD for validation. Docs: https://internal.docs/marketplace/validator

emily_partnerships: Proposed SKU pattern: `rw-acme-pro-trial-14d`. Partner suggests `acme-pro-14d` but we want `rw-` prefix for tracking. Any objections?

ben_sales: No objections. Note marketplace SKU length limit ~50 chars. Keep short.

zoe_legal: Draft UI copy: "Allow Redwood to collect anonymous usage metrics to improve product quality. Opt out anytime in settings." EULA snippet: "Anonymous telemetry may be collected for product improvement; EU customers can request deletion of telemetry tied to their tenancy." Will post finalized text.

kevin_eng: I'll scrub internal endpoints and placeholders in the manifest, add `kmsEncrypted: true` flag, and create the role. Who is owner for KMS key rotation?

emily_partnerships: Ops owns rotation, typically 90 days. ben, can you confirm with devops?

ben_sales: Yep, will confirm with devops and add contact. I'll wait to add partner rep to thread until manifest passes initial validation.

emily_partnerships: Next steps: kevin creates role + uploads scrubbed manifest, zoe finalizes telemetry text, ben confirms ops KMS owner. If validator returns errors we'll do a 15m follow-up. Thanks all :thumbsup:

marketplace_bot: Validation queued for s3://redwood-marketplace-manifests/ACMEAI-42/manifest.yaml  status: queued
